summary: Preserve full-detail condition evidence, distinct certification and HGJ verification, and bounded saved observations for explicit food and prayer planning.
reason: The public source streams HTML cards with hidden conditions and exposes separate restaurant and prayer-place evidence. Regeneration must retain canonical identity, unknown and inapplicable states, truthful cache semantics and local planning rather than converting raw cards or Muslim-friendly labels into compliance guarantees. Saved reads must fail explicitly during pending or changing WAL state rather than present checkpointed older observations as current. Final polish removes six proven-unused generated CLI helpers while preserving the helper-called dry-run detector.
validated_outcome: Real Tokyo searches and full details, five local plans and all nine MCP tools pass; the known food/prayer coordinate pair is 2.255 km and missing change baselines remain explicit.
